name: Soulver
soft_passes: #3 silhouette — solid-black fill is a plain squircle; subject carried by internal colour blocks + notepad fold, nameable only in grayscale not pure silhouette
#4 16px squint — yellow-header + 2x2 colour-block gestalt survives and reads as 'colourful calculator', but the $/%/clock/= glyphs smear to blobs; legible ~32px+
failures: #6 palette economy — 5 hue families (yellow header + red/green/purple/blue keys), no single reserved accent; purposeful multicolor-keypad signature but fails the <=2-hue rule
#10 variant robustness — not authored for Liquid Glass; meaning rides on the white paper ground + four distinct key colours, which collapse to identical blobs under tinted/mono/clear rendering

palette.background: scene: warm-white paper field #F9F8F4->#F6F6F5 with yellow header sheet ramp #F8D246->#F6CF39
palette.accent: none reserved — four equally-saturated keys (softened system hues)

light_model: Soft top-down; short soft drop shadows under keys and under each glyph; warm cast under the folded header edge; matte, no specular — Big Sur baked-shadow model, not Liquid Glass
layer_stack: yellow header sheet with page-fold + warm fold shadow
four saturated rounded-rect keys with soft drop shadows
white domain glyphs ($ % clock =) with micro drop shadows (front)
devices: notepad page-fold header (torn/folded top sheet revealing paper beneath)
multicolor 2x2 keypad as the glyph (rainbow = the multi-domain brand signal)
domain-glyph storytelling: $ currency / % percent / clock time / = math spells the feature set
concentric mask-echo corner: bottom-right key's outer radius enlarged to nest in the squircle
rhymes_hint: Big Sur multicolor-utility family — front-facing squircle with a saturated multi-hue element on a paper/neutral field; peers Apple Calculator & Numbers (multicolor grids) and Apple Notes/Stickies (yellow-paper header)
notes: icon.png is a clean 1024x1024 full-res original (SHA-1 710aa306), no resize artefacts. SOURCE MISMATCH: cover.webp depicts 'Supaste / Clipboard history', a DIFFERENT app, not Soulver — could not assess icon-to-app palette coherence. Keys are softened/tinted versions of macOS system hues (red #F44F58 vs system #FF383C, blue #48A4FD vs #0088FF) — friendlier-than-system palette, watch as possible recurring device. #6 and #10 are honest fails but #6 is signature-over-defect (subject-driven multicolor). Not yet updated to Liquid Glass/Tahoe.
